parameters.name: hostname

parameters.name: protocol-version

set system login user [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

authentication public-keys generate rsa.explanation: The command generates RSA public keys for authentication with a specified modulus size (`[parameter2]`), determining the key length for enhanced security.

parameters.name: modulus
parameters.explanation: Type length of RSA key, e.g. 2048.

set system login class [parameter1].explanation: This Junos command fragment defines a login class named `[parameter1]`, specifying permissions and access levels for users assigned to this class.

parameters.name: class-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the login class.

allow-commands [parameter2].explanation: The command `allow-commands [parameter2]` permits specific commands defined by `[parameter2]` to be executed within a Junos configuration or operational mode.

allow-rules to [parameter3].explanation: The command `allow-rules to [parameter3]` permits traffic matching the specified rules to reach the destination defined by `[parameter3]`.

parameters.name: allow-rules
parameters.explanation: Allowed rules, such as to root.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.
